Question
========
How did the useable speed increase from PCI Express 2 to PCI Express 3?


Answerlist
----------
* Number of lanes
* Bus speed (GT/s)
* Encoding
* Quantum bits

Solution
========
PCIe 3 raised the signalling rate from 5 to 8 GT/s and, at the same time, replaced the 8b/10b line code, which wasted 20 percent of the raw rate, by 128b/130b, which wastes about 1.5 percent. The two combined roughly double the useable bandwidth per lane.

Answerlist
----------
* 0. The number of lanes is a property of the slot, it did not change with the generation.
* 1. The signalling rate went from 5 GT/s to 8 GT/s.
* 1. 8b/10b was replaced by 128b/130b, which removes most of the encoding overhead.
* 0. Unrelated to PCI Express.
